content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity, LICENSE).**

- **§ 13.1** grants the Services licence to "Customer alone," expressly "without Affiliates or contractors," non-transferable, and "revocable at Vendor's sole discretion" — the exclusion of affiliates/contractors with no path to add them is walk-away territory.
- **§ 13.2** (perpetual, irrevocable, Affiliate- and contractor-enabled) does not cure this: it is scoped to paid-up software and Vendor Technology embedded in Deliverables, not the subscription Services.
- **§ 13.3** meets the fallback on transfer (Affiliate/successor) and on revocation (uncured material breach after notice and cure opportunity), but gives Affiliates and contractors no right to *use* the Services.

Redline (validated ok:true) extends the § 13.1 grant to our Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf and ties revocation/suspension and transfer to the standard already agreed in § 13.3, with the "Affiliates on written notice" fallback offered in the comment.
